name: DocHub
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For DocHub, fill, annotate, request low-stakes signatures, and track document versions. The hard boundary is google integrations, hosted collaboration, signature workflow, and document delivery, plus document fidelity, identity, and compliance.
